name: run_4_charts
title: Run it speed chart with one controller hidden

items.label: Controller tick box
items.text: After a run, unticking a controller hides it in the charts and the road view; ticking it shows it again. Nothing is run again.

items.label: Legend entry
items.text: Clicking a legend entry does the same: the crossed-out name is hidden. The speed, gap and energy charts and the road view all follow.

items.label: Chart
items.text: Move the mouse over a chart to see the same moment in the road view. Speed is in metres per second.

items.label: Gap and Energy tabs
items.text: Gap shows the distance to the lead car (the safe-gap rule is in the table note). Energy shows the cumulative battery energy.
